bayts.text: Guide us all upon the straight path, and be for us with what is sound, without what is sick.
To You is my address, O Near One (Al-Qarīb), O Answerer (Al-Mujīb), O You through Whom a wondrous good has constantly accompanied me.
Grant me and those who have attached themselves to me a guidance by which we are set free toward good.
You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help (Qurʾān 1:5): for You are the Worshipped and the Helper (Al-Muʿīn).
You have guided us, through You, to You, O Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), O He toward Whom, through Him, every (spiritual) chief directs himself.
O Lord of the straight path, grant us a guidance for which those who came before us will (holily) envy us.
